title: augustinea major
intro: Augustinea major, commonly known as Peruvian mint or Cat's Claw Mint, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Augustinea major include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Augustinea major include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
